name: Thought
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of guarding and renewing our thoughts, recognizing that our inner life shapes the course of our existence (Proverbs 4:23). By fixing our minds on God and His truth, we experience perfect peace and are transformed to discern and follow His will (Isaiah 26:3; Romans 12:2). Believers are called to focus their thoughts on what is pure, honorable, and praiseworthy, rejecting bad, evil, impure, and naughty thoughts in favor of those that reflect God's character and goodness (Philippians 4:8).
